name: Disinterested Observer
text: **Disinterested Observer**: Elves who frequently interact with shorterlived species, especially members who hail from Varisia, often come to rely on their ability to weight out such impatient races. These elves gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls and skill checks made as part of readied actions in combat. This racial trait replaces the elven magic and weapon familiarity traits.
